matched_packages.name: MaoDingA/moonpost
matched_packages.summary:
MoonPost is a MoonBit toolkit for subtitle, timecode, and post-production QC. It provides parsing/writing for SRT, WebVTT, and ASS formats, SMPTE timecode conversion, and QC profiles for creator (gentle) and delivery (strict) workflows. It supports retiming, bilingual subtitle merging/splitting, JSON reports, and failure exit codes for automation.
